D: A magazine writer tries to drive a man away in ten days while he tries to make her fall for him.
P: Serve the mains when Ben takes Andie home to meet his family on Staten Island.
S: Toasted baguette slices with lemony whipped ricotta, blistered roasted cherry tomatoes, torn basil and a drizzle of honey. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes with oil and salt for 15 minutes. Whip 250g ricotta with lemon zest and pepper, spread on the toasts and top with tomatoes, basil and a little honey.

Crumbed risotto balls with peas, ham and parmesan, fried golden and crisp, with a bowl of warm marinara for dunking. Make a firm risotto with 300g arborio rice and 1L stock, stir through 100g peas, 100g diced ham and 50g parmesan, then cool. Roll into 16 balls, crumb in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 400g warm marinara.
Andie's job writing for Composure magazine

Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers and thin red onion. Split 8 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 200g cream cheese with the zest of 1 lemon, chopped dill and pepper. Spread thickly on the bagel halves. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers and very thin slices of red onion. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and a dill sprig and serve on a board.
M: Ben's family dinner on Staten Island
Beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, served over rigatoni with plenty of parmesan, family style.
Diamond ball eye fillet and red wine
the diamond ball where Andie wears the yellow dress

Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and asparagus. Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes. Slice 1kg potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g butter. Serve with steamed asparagus.
W: Sweet pastry filled with a lemon curd of juice, zest, eggs, sugar and butter, baked at 150C for 20 minutes until just set.
K: Andie losing her voice courtside at the basketball

Cold lager topped with spicy ginger beer and lime in plastic cups, with a mint sprig standing in for the love fern. All ginger beer for non-drinkers. Chill 4 tall plastic cups or glasses. Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each. Pour in 200ml cold lager, tilting the cup, then top with 150ml cold ginger beer. Drop a lime wedge and a mint sprig in each and serve straight away. For non-drinkers, fill with ginger beer and a splash of soda water.

m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with breadcrumbs and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Toss through 500g cooked rigatoni with plenty of parmesan.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons with 4 eggs, 150g sugar and 150ml cream. Pour into the case and bake at 150C for 20 minutes until just set. Chill and serve with whipped cream.
